description: Pairs a place presence interval (derived from device samples) with a call, message or e-mail whose time lies within the interval or a tolerance around it. A hypothesis for human review: a device at a place and communication activity at that time do not show who communicated, from where, or with which device.

criteria.inner_overlap_s: seconds of overlap between the communication range [t_lo, max(t_end, t_hi)] and the interval's observed span
criteria.inner_gap_s: smallest distance between both ranges (0 when inside); the gate is inner_gap_s <= tolerance_s
criteria.within_outer_bounds: the communication time lies inside [outer_start, outer_end]
criteria.same_stream_hint: never computed: nothing links a communication event to the device stream of the presence; recorded as unknown
criteria.time_basis: basis of the communication time from the timeline projection

probability: none: hypotheses carry per-criterion evidence only; acceptance is a human decision
